newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel opens brewery in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel opens brewery in Indonesia.

text.p: The Philippines' San Miguel Corp and its partners in PT Delta Djakarta recently opened a $66.4 million brewery in Indonesia.

In a statement issued on Monday, San Miguel said the 15-hectare site in the Bekasi Industrial Estate located 20 kilometres from the capital has a fully computerised brewhouse, automated filtration, bottling and canning line and a wastewater treatment plant.

Aside from the PT Delta brewery, San Miguel's investments in Indonesia include a joint venture with PT Sampoerna Percetakan Nusantara for the manufacture of plastic crates and with Dharmala Agrifood for an integrated feeds and poultry processing project.
